meta.notes: SETUP — 1. Import into n8n (Workflows > Import from File). 2. Create three Header Auth credentials (Credentials > New > Header Auth): 'DeepSeek key' with Name=Authorization Value=Bearer sk-...; 'Gemini key' with Name=x-goog-api-key Value=AIza...; 'ElevenLabs key' with Name=xi-api-key Value=sk_... (optional). 3. Open each HTTP node and pick its credential from the dropdown. 4. Activate the workflow and copy the PRODUCTION webhook URL. 5. Open demo.html?hook=<that url>. Frontend sends { action, system, user } for theme/reply/learn, { action:'picto', label, tint }, { action:'speak', text, voiceId }, and { action:'portrait', character, film }. The portrait route runs DeepSeek first to abstract the character into an ORIGINAL gel-creature brief — no names, no franchise references — and only that brief reaches the image model. ALERT ROUTE: { action:'alert', person, contacts, seconds, at, chatId } -> Compose alert -> Telegram. Swap the Telegram node for Gmail, Slack or Twilio if you prefer; only the Compose node writes the wording. That wording is deliberate: the flag reports a movement pattern and asks someone to check. It must never claim to know what happened.
